clauses.text: This Agreement is entered into between [CLIENT_NAME] ("Client") and [PROVIDER_NAME] ("Service Provider").
This Agreement governs the provision of painting services by the Service Provider to the Client at [PROPERTY_ADDRESS].

The Service Provider shall perform the painting work described in [SURFACES_TO_BE_PAINTED], including surface preparation, application of primer where needed, and application of the agreed number of coats.

The Services shall use the paint brand, type, and finish specified in [PAINT_BRAND_AND_TYPE], in the colors specified in [COLOR_SPECIFICATIONS]. Unless otherwise agreed in writing, the Service Provider shall supply all paint and painting materials, and the cost is included in [TOTAL_VALUE].
The Services shall begin on [START_DATE] and are expected to be completed by [COMPLETION_DATE], subject to weather conditions, site access, and any change orders agreed between the Parties.
The Client shall pay the Service Provider [TOTAL_VALUE] for the Services, payable via [PAYMENT_METHOD]. A deposit of [DEPOSIT_AMOUNT] is due before work begins, with the balance due upon completion.
If the Client fails to pay any amount due by its due date, the Service Provider may charge interest on the overdue amount at [LATE_PAYMENT_RATE] per month.

The Service Provider shall cover and protect furniture, flooring, and fixtures reasonably at risk from the Services. The Client shall provide the Service Provider with reasonable access to [PROPERTY_ADDRESS], including electricity and water where needed, during agreed working hours.

Surface preparation, including scraping, sanding, patching minor cracks or holes, and masking, is included in the Services unless expressly excluded. Repair of substantial structural damage, mold remediation, or lead paint abatement is not included unless separately agreed in writing.

Where the Client requests a color change, additional coats, or work on surfaces not included in [SURFACES_TO_BE_PAINTED] after the Services have begun, the Parties shall agree the additional cost and any schedule impact in writing before the additional work is performed.
Upon completion, the Service Provider shall remove painting debris, empty containers, and masking materials from the site and leave the work areas broom-clean.

Where the Services include exterior painting, the Service Provider may reschedule work affected by rain, extreme temperature, or humidity outside the paint manufacturer's application specifications, and shall notify the Client of any resulting adjustment to [COMPLETION_DATE].

The Service Provider warrants the workmanship of the Services against peeling, blistering, or improper adhesion attributable to defective application for [WARRANTY_PERIOD] from [COMPLETION_DATE]. This warranty excludes damage from normal wear, moisture intrusion unrelated to the Services, or third-party alterations.

The Client shall remove or arrange the removal of valuable or fragile items from the work area before the Services begin, and shall promptly disclose any known issue, such as mold, water damage, or lead-based paint, affecting the surfaces to be painted.
The Service Provider shall maintain general liability insurance covering its work under this Agreement and shall provide proof of coverage upon the Client's reasonable request.
Neither Party shall be liable to the other for any indirect, incidental, or consequential loss arising from this Agreement.
Each Party's total liability arising from this Agreement shall not exceed [TOTAL_VALUE], except for loss arising from gross negligence, willful misconduct, or fraud.

Neither Party shall be liable for a failure to perform its obligations to the extent that failure results from an event beyond that Party's reasonable control that could not have been avoided through reasonable diligence. The affected Party shall notify the other Party without undue delay.
This Agreement shall be governed by [APPLICABLE_LAW]. Any dispute shall be submitted to [DISPUTE_RESOLUTION_MECHANISM] before litigation, except where interim injunctive relief is required.
The Parties have executed this Agreement as of [SIGNATURE_DATE].
